people.name: Hiram
people.line: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because Yahweh loves his people, he has made you king over them.”
translations.bsb: Then Hiram king of Tyre wrote a letter in reply to Solomon: “Because the LORD loves His people, He has set you over them as king.”
translations.kjv: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
translations.asv: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because Jehovah loveth his people, he hath made thee king over them.
